name: Teen Lounge, Fleisher Art Memorial
what_you_do: Drop in after school for free art workshops (cyanotype photography, papermaking, book arts) and free studio days. Snacks and bus passes are provided.
who_can_apply: Teens. The page does not list ages or grades.
pay_detail: Free. No attendance requirement. Snacks and bus passes provided.
duration: Tuesdays and Wednesdays, 4 to 6 pm, while Philadelphia schools are in session. Fall 2026 workshops start Sept 8.
deadline_text: Teen Lounge 2026-2027 runs during the school year. Fall workshops started Tuesday, Sept 8, 2026. It is drop in.
how_to_apply: Drop in at 719 Catharine St, or email cy@fleisher.org.
notes: Not a job. Lead support from the William Penn Foundation and others is listed on the page.
